ai_hints: GitHub Actions: untrusted input interpolated into run: scripts, pull_request_target checking out PR code, over-broad permissions, third-party actions not pinned to a commit SHA, secrets exposed to forks, missing concurrency/timeouts, self-hosted runners on public repos.

message.es: Corre con secretos y permisos de escritura. No hagas checkout ni ejecutes código del PR en este contexto.
message.en: Runs with secrets and write permissions. Do not checkout or execute PR code in this context.

title.en: Action not pinned to a SHA

message.es: Un tag es mutable (supply chain). Fija el commit SHA completo.
message.en: A tag is mutable (supply chain). Pin the full commit SHA.

title.es: Entrada no confiable interpolada (inyección de scripts)

message.es: Si se usa dentro de run:, el atacante controla el comando. Pásalo por una variable de entorno y cítalo.
message.en: If used inside run:, the attacker controls the command. Pass it through an env var and quote it.

message.es: Concede escritura total al GITHUB_TOKEN. Declara solo los permisos necesarios.
message.en: Grants full write to GITHUB_TOKEN. Declare only the permissions needed.
